name: C&D International Investment Group Limited
summary: C&D International Investment Group Limited, founded in 1993 and headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong, is an investment holding company and subsidiary of Well Land International Limited. It focuses on property development, real estate industry chain investment services and industrial investments in mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan and elsewhere. It leases commercial, residential and industrial property, builds and sells homes and parking, and provides project management and consultancy. It was formerly South West Eco Development Limited.
